name: Imelda Rivera's Roasted Chicken Breast in Oaxacan Mole Negro (Night 2)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Plaza de Coco (Día de los Muertos Night 2)
whyItWorks: The roasted chicken breast and white rice are 9/10 flare-safe, while the Oaxacan mole sauce contains chilies, spices, and sesame seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the Roasted Chicken Breast with the Mole Negro sauce strictly on the side (and hold the toasted sesame seed sprinkle) so you have a clean chicken-and-rice meal.
watchOuts: Dried chilies, garlic, and nuts/seeds in Oaxacan mole sauce
